column1: Mix the flour and yogurt in a large bowl, then knead about 5 minutes into a soft, springy dough, adding a little flour if sticky. Cover and set aside.
Combine all the filling ingredients in a bowl, making sure the spinach is squeezed completely dry.
Knead the rested dough briefly and divide into 4 equal pieces.
Flatten one piece to about 3/4 inch thick, spoon a heaping tablespoon of filling into the middle, gather the edges over the filling and pinch to seal.
Turn the parcel seam-side down and press it out to about 1/2 inch thick. Dust with flour and repeat with the rest.
Heat a dry nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the flatbreads 3–5 minutes per side until golden brown.
Stir together the mint sauce and olive oil and serve with the flatbreads, warm or at room temperature.
